source: TrustLensAI_DeepLearning_Logs_Layers_Formulas.xlsx — sheet 'Deep Learning RMTE (Master)' plus 'Logs ↔ Formula Inputs' and 'Logs ↔ Architecture Layers'
notes: Each Deep Learning pipeline stage emits telemetry; TrustLensAI platform layers ingest and evaluate it. TrustLensAI produces evidence; it does not certify compliance.

layers.key_fields: raw data, source, modality, timestamps
layers.ingested_by: L0 · Foundation & Integration → L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry

layers.key_fields: completeness, annotation accuracy, class balance, distribution coverage
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L5 · Risk & Governance

layers.key_fields: normalization, augmentation applied, augmentation coverage
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry

layers.key_fields: learned features/embeddings (refs), probe results
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.key_fields: architecture, hyperparameters, design rationale, parameter count
layers.ingested_by: L0 · Foundation & Integration → L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry

layers.key_fields: loss curves, gradient norms, seed variance, epochs, compute FLOPs/GPU-hours, ε
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.key_fields: confidence bins, ECE inputs, uncertainty estimates (MC dropout/ensemble)
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.key_fields: predictions, logits, per-subgroup outputs, task metrics
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.key_fields: feature attribution (GradCAM/SHAP/attention), deletion/insertion tests
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.key_fields: adversarial-attack outcomes, noise robustness, certified radius, physical attacks
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L5 · Risk & Governance

layers.key_fields: memorization/extraction test, membership inference, model inversion, DP ε/δ
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L5 · Risk & Governance

layers.key_fields: latency (p50/95/99), throughput, model size, post-compression accuracy, carbon
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry

layers.key_fields: drift, model registry, incidents & MTTR, ethical assessment, TEVV
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L2 · Observability → L5 · Risk & Governance

layers.key_fields: registered DL models, data connectors, tenancy, model registry & lineage
layers.ingested_by: Anchors identity, model registry & tenancy for all logs

layers.key_fields: normalized training/inference spans/events, redaction, event-bus refs
layers.ingested_by: Consumes all DL product logs; normalizes & redacts

layers.key_fields: reconstructed training/inference traces, dependency views, time-series (drift)
layers.ingested_by: Consumes canonical events (D1-gated / target)

layers.key_fields: evaluator outputs, task metrics, calibration, robustness, attribution scores
layers.ingested_by: Consumes inference/training/robustness logs + gold sets

layers.key_fields: metric defs, thresholds, mappings, gold benchmarks & test sets, versions
layers.ingested_by: Supplies formulas/thresholds & reference data to L3
layers.notes: Governs the DL RMTE metric corpus

layers.key_fields: fairness, privacy, safety-critical decisions, risk register, gates
layers.ingested_by: Consumes evaluation evidence; runs release gates

layers.key_fields: Evidence Pack manifest, RFC 6962 inclusion proofs / hashes, Trust Score (Q6)
layers.ingested_by: Assembles tamper-evident evidence + verdict

layers.key_fields: persona surfaces, scorecards, reports, notifications
layers.ingested_by: Consumes evidence & verdicts for reporting
